name: CostControlPanel

states.name: Page Structure & Layout
states.description: Overall layout of the Cost Control panel: header with title and refresh button, followed by budget warnings, summary cards, budget gauge + phase chart, safety section, cost feed table, and optimization recommendations.
states.precondition: Data is still loading (isLoading is true)

states.name: Summary Metric Cards
states.description: Four metric cards in a responsive grid showing Total Cost, Total Tokens, Cache Hit Rate, and Cache Savings. Uses 2 columns on mobile, 4 on desktop.

states.name: Budget Utilization Gauge
states.description: Circular SVG gauge showing budget utilization percentage. Color-coded: green (<60% used), yellow (60-80%), red (>80%). Shows cost amounts and remaining percentage below the gauge.
states.precondition: No workflow run is currently active

states.name: Cost by Phase Chart
states.description: Horizontal bar chart showing cost per workflow phase using recharts. Sorted by cost descending. Custom tooltip with token breakdown.
states.precondition: No phase cost data in the database

states.name: Circuit Breaker Status
states.description: Card showing the cost circuit breaker state: green Shield icon with 'Closed' badge when healthy, red ShieldAlert icon with 'Tripped' badge when triggered. Shows anomaly detector stats.

states.name: Anomaly Detection Feed
states.description: Scrollable list of detected cost anomalies with z-scores, costs, and mean values. Yellow-tinted cards with severity indicators.
states.precondition: No cost anomalies detected during the current or recent runs

states.name: Budget Warning Banner
states.description: Dismissible alert banner at the top of the page when budget warnings fire (>80% consumed). Shows remaining percentage, warning message, cost amounts, and dismiss button.
states.precondition: A budget warning event has been emitted (budget >80% consumed)

states.name: Recent Cost Events Table
states.description: Scrollable table showing the last 50 cost events with time, phase, iteration, token counts, cost, cumulative cost, and cache hit rate. Newest events first.
states.precondition: No workflow runs have generated cost events

states.name: Optimization Recommendations
states.description: Section showing cost optimization recommendations from the meta-optimizer and dashboard-derived insights. Includes cache efficiency, duplicate prompt detection, and model downgrade suggestions.

states.name: Visual Design & Styling
states.description: Design token compliance, color scheme, typography, and card styling across the Cost Control panel.

states.name: Real-Time Data Flow
states.description: Real-time event subscription behavior: cost events update the feed table, budget warnings trigger the banner, anomaly events populate the anomaly feed, and dashboard queries refresh on cost events.
states.precondition: A workflow run is active and making AI calls

states.name: Budget & Safety State Consistency
states.description: Validates that the displayed budget, circuit breaker, and anomaly data is internally consistent and reflects the actual state of the cost management engine.

description: Cost Control Panel — real-time budget tracking, cost anomaly detection, circuit breaker status, and cost optimization recommendations. Provides live monitoring during active workflow runs and historical cost analysis when idle. Budget gauge, phase breakdown chart, cost event feed, and recommendation engine.
